name: Reprieve
author: Greyforge Labs
description: A safety net for Super+W on Omarchy: the window is hidden, not terminated, and one keystroke returns it exactly as it was. Survives shell restarts.

barWidget.description: Parked windows: count, per-window icons to restore, setup/health indicator. Click for the timeline.

schema.label: Widget colours
schema.description: Brand keeps Reprieve's cyan angel and amber markers. Theme makes it two-tone like the other bar icons: wings in the bar text colour, halo and parked markers in your Omarchy accent. Accent paints the whole angel in the accent. Alerts still use the theme's urgent colour. Options: brand, theme (bar text + accent), accent (solid accent).
